entrypoint.ownership: Thin orchestration only; mutation-family rules remain owned by existing guarded adapters.

explicit_boundaries: Do not replace issue conclusion, relationship attach, PR body rewrite, or PR create family-specific logic with one flat super-command.
Do not collapse PR create branch materialization, remote publish, or live PR publish into the thin gate planner.
Do not delegate thin-gate apply through pr-create-preflight; that family remains front-half planning only until later create stages are explicitly wrapped.
Do not let publish-time or CI wrappers reinterpret family-specific post-apply verify logic into a fake universal success schema.
Do not widen the entrypoint into prose quality review, summary rewriting, or blank-field inference.
